scenes.title: NYU student pushing open the isolated intercom cubicle door in 52 seconds vs hesitating under the 6-channel light panel
scenes.era: 1968, New York University psychology corridor, Manhattan

layout.description: Brightly lit 1968 university corridor lined with numbered sound-attenuated cubicles; inside Cubicle 1 sits a small wooden desk, padded studio headphones, a desktop intercom box with six numbered channel indicator bulbs, and a stopwatch in the hallway.

positions.who: Solo-Condition Student (mannequin in 1968 corduroy jacket and turtleneck)
positions.where: bursting swiftly out of Cubicle 1 doorway with headphones still held in one hand to alert the hallway researcher

positions.who: Six-Group Student in adjacent view / booth (mannequin in 1968 knit sweater)
positions.where: seated tensely inside a booth staring at FIVE lit channel bulbs on the intercom box, hands clasped anxiously on the desk

positions.who: John Darley (mannequin in 1968 suit and tie)
positions.where: standing at the corridor desk clicking a chrome stopwatch at 52 seconds

props.name: six-bulb desktop intercom unit
props.period_detail: 1968 brushed-metal intercom box with numbered amber lamps showing either 2 active booths or all 6 active booths
props.physical_behavior: five extra lit lamps cut rescue probability from 85% down to 31%

props.name: over-ear padded intercom headphones
props.period_detail: black 1960s studio headset resting half-lifted on the desk

props.name: corridor response-time ledger
props.period_detail: clipboard chart showing 85% (52s) for 2-person vs 31% (166s) for 6-person condition

actions.verb_sequence: hears distress over the two-lamp intercom -> rips off headphones -> pushes open the booth door in 52 seconds
hears the identical recording -> looks at the five other lit channel bulbs assuming someone else already left -> stays frozen with clasped hands

reactions.reaction: leans forward anxiously when the researcher finally opens the door, relieved to ask if the peer is safe
logs how four unseen listeners tripled hesitation time

scenes.wardrobe: 1968 NYC collegiate attire: corduroy sport coats, fine-knit turtlenecks, button-down Oxford shirts, wool slacks.
scenes.lighting: Clean high-key 1968 institutional corridor and booth daylight.
scenes.recognition_hook: Hearing the exact same medical emergency through headphones, 85 percent of students bolt out the door when they think they're alone — versus just 31 percent when five other booth lights glow.

key_visual.description: a 1968 college student rushing out of a numbered soundproof cubicle holding intercom headphones toward a corridor researcher while a six-bulb intercom box glows on the desk

scenes.title: Columbia waiting room filling with white vent smoke beside calm confederates

layout.description: Brightly lit 1968 office waiting room where harmless white titanium-dioxide mist curls steadily through a wall air vent while three men fill out questionnaires.

positions.where: waving away white mist from his clipboard while glancing sideways at two utterly calm confederates
shrugging mildly and continuing to write without looking up

props.name: wall air-vent mist & survey clipboards
props.period_detail: white mist drifting across the room
props.physical_behavior: reported 75% of the time alone, but only 10% beside calm actors

actions.verb_sequence: looks alarmingly at the vent -> checks the two calm actors -> goes back to writing in pluralistic ignorance

scenes.recognition_hook: Seated beside two calm actors, nine out of ten students kept filling out forms as thick white smoke filled the room.

scenes.title: Trembling hands inside the six-person booth prove conflict, not apathy

layout.description: Open doorway of Cubicle 4 at the six-minute mark.

positions.where: opening the cubicle door gently as the seated student looks up anxiously

props.name: six-bulb intercom box
props.physical_behavior: created an agonizing stalemate of 'surely someone else went'

actions.verb_sequence: stands immediately asking anxiously about the other student's health

reactions.reaction: reassures the visibly shaken participant during debriefing

scenes.recognition_hook: Non-helpers weren't cold-hearted — they were sweating and trembling inside a responsibility trap.

scenes.title: Pointing to one person in a blue jacket during a sidewalk stumble

layout.description: Sunlit modern plaza where a helper kneels beside a dizzy commuter and points directly at one specific bystander.

positions.where: kneeling steadily and pointing one clear arm toward a commuter in a navy jacket
pulling out smartphone immediately upon being singled out

props.name: smartphone dialing emergency services
props.physical_behavior: direct assignment restores the 85% solo response

actions.verb_sequence: points directly at one person -> Navy-Jacket Commuter steps forward and dials immediately

reactions.reaction: clears space cooperatively once roles are clear

scenes.wardrobe: Modern navy jacket and smart-casual commuter wear.
scenes.recognition_hook: Pointing to ONE specific person shatters diffusion of responsibility in two seconds.
